introduction: This spec defines the workspace code checkout system for af-hub: when a workspace is created, the upstream git repository is cloned asynchronously into a local directory; archiving pushes local commits and removes the clone; reactivating re-clones; and deleting cleans up any remaining files.

glossary.CloneOptions: The go-git struct configuring a clone operation, including URL, Depth, SingleBranch, and ReferenceName fields.
glossary.DELETE /api/v1/workspaces/:slug: The HTTP endpoint for deleting an archived workspace.
glossary.NewBranchReferenceName: The go-git/plumbing function func NewBranchReferenceName(name string) ReferenceName that returns refs/heads/<name>.
glossary.NoErrAlreadyUpToDate: A sentinel error value from go-git indicating the remote already has all local commits; treated as success during push.
glossary.POST /api/v1/workspaces: The HTTP endpoint for creating a new workspace.
glossary.POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/archive: The HTTP endpoint for archiving an existing workspace.
glossary.POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/reactivate: The HTTP endpoint for reactivating an archived workspace.
glossary.PlainCloneContext: The go-git function func PlainCloneContext(ctx context.Context, path string, isBare bool, o *CloneOptions) (*Repository, error) used to perform a shallow git clone with context cancellation support.
glossary.PlainOpen: The go-git function func PlainOpen(path string) (*Repository, error) used to open an existing local git repository.
glossary.PushOptions: The go-git struct configuring a push operation, including RemoteName.
glossary.WORKSPACE_ROOT: The resolved root directory under which all workspace subdirectories are stored, derived from the [workspace] path config value.
glossary.WorkspaceConfig: A Go struct added to apikit's config package holding workspace-specific configuration: Path and Workers.
glossary.XDG_DATA_HOME: An environment variable specifying the base directory for user-specific data files, used during workspace path resolution.
glossary.afc workspace create: The CLI command that calls POST /api/v1/workspaces to create a new workspace.
glossary.afc workspace get: The CLI command that calls GET /api/v1/workspaces/:slug to retrieve workspace details including clone_status.
glossary.branch: A nullable TEXT column on the workspaces table storing the git branch to clone; NULL means clone the remote's default branch.
glossary.clone job: A unit of work enqueued on the job queue representing a shallow git clone operation for a specific workspace.
glossary.clone_error: A nullable TEXT column on the workspaces table storing the error message from the most recent failed clone attempt.
glossary.clone_status: A TEXT column on the workspaces table tracking the state of the local git clone: pending, cloning, ready, failed, or archived.
glossary.config.toml: The TOML configuration file read by apikit's Load() function to configure the hub server.
glossary.git_url: A TEXT column on the workspaces table storing the upstream git repository URL to clone from.
glossary.head_sha: A nullable TEXT column on the workspaces table storing the 40-character hex SHA of the HEAD commit of the local clone.
glossary.job queue: An in-memory FIFO channel-backed queue of clone and reclone jobs consumed by worker goroutines.
glossary.reclone job: A clone job enqueued during workspace reactivation; performs the same operation as an initial clone job.
glossary.resolveDataPath: An internal apikit config function that resolves a bare path name against XDG_DATA_HOME or a default fallback.
glossary.trunk: The subdirectory within a workspace's directory that holds the shallow git clone of the upstream repository.
glossary.workers: The number of goroutine workers consuming jobs from the job queue, configured via [workspace] workers in config.toml.
glossary.workspace slug: The primary key TEXT identifier for a workspace, used as the subdirectory name under WORKSPACE_ROOT.

user_story.benefit: the server knows where to store workspace clones and how many concurrent clone workers to run

acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns (*Config, nil) with Workspace.Path = "./workspace" and Workspace.Workers = 4

acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns (*Config, nil) with Workspace.Workers = 4 and Workspace.Path resolved per the empty-path rule

requirements.title: New workspace fields added to schema and response

user_story.goal: see clone_status, head_sha, and clone_error on every workspace response
user_story.benefit: I can monitor clone progress and diagnose failures without additional API calls

acceptance_criteria.action: includes columns clone_status (TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'), head_sha (TEXT nullable), and clone_error (TEXT nullable) as defined in the updated DDL

acceptance_criteria.return_contract: JSON object contains clone_status (string), head_sha (string | null), clone_error (string | null)

acceptance_criteria.action: enforces that clone_status is one of: pending, cloning, ready, failed, archived

edge_cases.action: sets clone_status to "pending", head_sha to NULL, and clone_error to NULL in the database row and response
edge_cases.return_contract: JSON response contains clone_status = "pending", head_sha = null, clone_error = null

edge_cases.action: returns clone_status = "ready" and a non-null head_sha containing a 40-character hex SHA

requirements.title: Async clone job queue with configurable workers

user_story.goal: have git clones execute asynchronously in the background
user_story.benefit: workspace creation returns immediately without blocking on potentially slow network operations

acceptance_criteria.action: initializes an in-memory FIFO job queue backed by a Go channel and starts workers goroutines (count = Workspace.Workers, default 4) that consume jobs from the queue

a worker goroutine picks up the job, sets clone_status to "cloning" on the workspace record, creates the workspace directory under WORKSPACE_ROOT, and performs a shallow clone (Depth: 1) of git_url into <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/<slug>/trunk/ using PlainCloneContext with a context derived from the server's root context
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a clone job or reclone job is enqueued

acceptance_criteria.action: sets clone_status to "ready", records the HEAD commit SHA in head_sha via repo.Head().Hash().String(), and clears clone_error to NULL
sets clone_status to "failed", records the error message in clone_error, and removes any partially created workspace directory
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: clone_status is set to "failed" in the database, clone_error contains the error message, and any partial workspace directory is removed from disk

acceptance_criteria.action: skips the clone and sets clone_status to "ready" without calling PlainCloneContext
acceptance_criteria.condition: the workspace directory already exists under WORKSPACE_ROOT

acceptance_criteria.action: clones the specified branch by setting SingleBranch to true and ReferenceName to NewBranchReferenceName(branch) in CloneOptions
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a clone job is picked up
acceptance_criteria.condition: branch is non-null on the workspace record

acceptance_criteria.action: clones the remote's default branch by omitting ReferenceName from CloneOptions
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a clone job is picked up
acceptance_criteria.condition: branch is null on the workspace record

edge_cases.action: cancels the server's root context, causing in-progress PlainCloneContext calls to be interrupted and pending jobs in the queue to be discarded without processing
edge_cases.trigger: a graceful shutdown signal is received

edge_cases.action: the clone is interrupted when the server's root context is cancelled; the worker sets clone_status to "failed" and removes any partially created workspace directory
edge_cases.return_contract: clone_status is set to "failed" in the database and any partial workspace directory is removed from disk
edge_cases.error_condition: PlainCloneContext does not return within a reasonable time (network hang or unresponsive remote)

edge_cases.action: removes the partially created workspace directory using os.RemoveAll before setting clone_status to "failed"
edge_cases.return_contract: the partial workspace directory is removed from disk and clone_status is set to "failed" in the database
edge_cases.error_condition: the workspace directory was partially created before the error occurred

edge_cases.action: sets clone_status to "failed" and records the error message in clone_error; does not retry
edge_cases.return_contract: clone_status is set to "failed" in the database and clone_error contains the network or remote error message
edge_cases.error_condition: git_url is unreachable or returns an error

edge_cases.action: PlainCloneContext returns an error; worker sets clone_status to "failed" and records the error in clone_error
edge_cases.return_contract: clone_status is set to "failed" in the database and clone_error contains the branch-not-found error message

edge_cases.action: sets clone_status to "failed" and records the error in clone_error; removes the workspace directory
edge_cases.return_contract: clone_status is set to "failed" in the database, clone_error contains the Head() error message, and the workspace directory is removed from disk
edge_cases.error_condition: repo.Head() returns an error after a successful clone

requirements.title: Workspace creation enqueues clone job and returns immediately

user_story.goal: create a workspace via POST /api/v1/workspaces and get an immediate response
user_story.benefit: I don't have to wait for the git clone to complete before the API responds

acceptance_criteria.action: inserts the workspace metadata row with clone_status = "pending", enqueues a clone job on the job queue, and returns HTTP 201 with the workspace JSON immediately without waiting for the clone to complete
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 201 with JSON workspace object containing clone_status = "pending", head_sha = null, clone_error = null

edge_cases.action: returns an error response without enqueuing a clone job
edge_cases.return_contract: returns HTTP 500 with JSON error body
edge_cases.error_condition: the database insert fails

edge_cases.action: the enqueue operation blocks until a worker frees capacity or uses a non-blocking send that logs a warning; the HTTP 201 response is still returned to the caller
edge_cases.return_contract: returns HTTP 201 with JSON workspace object containing clone_status = "pending"
edge_cases.condition: the job queue channel is full

requirements.title: Archive workspace pushes local commits and removes clone

user_story.goal: archive a workspace and have local commits pushed to upstream before the clone is deleted
user_story.benefit: no local work is lost when the workspace is archived and disk space is reclaimed

acceptance_criteria.action: opens the local repository at <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/<slug>/trunk/ via PlainOpen, pushes to origin via repo.Push(&PushOptions{RemoteName: "origin"}), records the HEAD SHA in head_sha, deletes the workspace directory, sets clone_status to "archived", sets status to "archived", and updates updated_at
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 200 with JSON workspace object containing status = "archived", clone_status = "archived", and the recorded head_sha

acceptance_criteria.action: removes any partial workspace directory if it exists, sets clone_status to "archived", sets status to "archived", and updates updated_at without attempting any git push
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 200 with JSON workspace object containing status = "archived", clone_status = "archived"

acceptance_criteria.action: rejects the archive request with HTTP 409 and message "clone in progress; try again after it completes"
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 409 with JSON error body containing message "clone in progress; try again after it completes"

acceptance_criteria.action: aborts the archive, does not delete the workspace directory, and returns HTTP 500 with the push error message
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 500 with JSON error body containing the push error message; workspace status and clone_status remain unchanged
acceptance_criteria.error_condition: repo.Push returns an error other than NoErrAlreadyUpToDate

acceptance_criteria.action: treats the push as successful and continues with recording head_sha, deleting the workspace directory, and setting clone_status to "archived"
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns HTTP 200 with JSON workspace object containing status = "archived", clone_status = "archived", and the recorded head_sha

user_story.goal: have clone_status transition correctly through its defined states
user_story.benefit: I can rely on clone_status to accurately reflect the state of the local clone

acceptance_criteria.action: enforces that clone_status transitions follow the defined state machine: pending→cloning, cloning→ready, cloning→failed, ready→archived, pending→archived, failed→archived, archived→pending
only allows transition to "pending" via the reactivate endpoint

edge_cases.action: rejects the transition with HTTP 409
edge_cases.return_contract: returns HTTP 409 with JSON error body containing message "clone in progress; try again after it completes"

correctness_properties.title: Clone status always reflects terminal or in-progress state
correctness_properties.invariant: clone_status is one of: pending, cloning, ready, failed, archived

correctness_properties.title: head_sha is set if and only if clone succeeded or archive completed
correctness_properties.invariant: head_sha is non-null if and only if clone_status is "ready" or clone_status is "archived" (and the archive was preceded by a successful clone)

correctness_properties.title: clone_error is null when clone_status is not failed
correctness_properties.invariant: clone_error is null whenever clone_status is pending, cloning, ready, or archived

correctness_properties.title: Workspace directory exists if and only if clone_status is ready or cloning
correctness_properties.invariant: the directory <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/<slug>/ exists on disk if and only if clone_status is "cloning" or "ready"; it does not exist when clone_status is pending, failed, or archived

correctness_properties.title: Workers config defaults to 4 when unset or zero
correctness_properties.for_any: config.toml with workers = 0 or omitted [workspace] section
correctness_properties.invariant: Workspace.Workers is always >= 1 after Load() returns

correctness_properties.title: Archive of cloning workspace always returns 409
correctness_properties.invariant: POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/archive always returns HTTP 409 and never modifies clone_status or status

correctness_properties.title: Shallow clone depth is always 1
correctness_properties.invariant: CloneOptions.Depth is always set to 1; deep clones are never performed

correctness_properties.title: head_sha is a valid 40-character hex SHA when non-null

execution_paths.title: Happy path: workspace create to clone ready

steps.action: calls afc workspace create with a git_url and optional branch
sends POST /api/v1/workspaces with git_url, branch, and other metadata
inserts workspace row with clone_status = "pending" and returns HTTP 201 immediately
enqueues a clone job on the in-memory job queue
picks up the clone job and sets clone_status to "cloning" in the database
creates the workspace directory under WORKSPACE_ROOT and calls PlainCloneContext to shallow-clone git_url into <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/<slug>/trunk/
on success, calls repo.Head().Hash().String() to get the HEAD SHA, sets clone_status to "ready" and head_sha to the SHA in the database
calls afc workspace get to observe clone_status = "ready" and the recorded head_sha

execution_paths.title: Happy path: archive workspace with local commits

steps.action: calls POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/archive on a workspace with clone_status = "ready"
verifies clone_status is "ready" and opens the local repository via PlainOpen at <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/<slug>/trunk/
calls repo.Push with PushOptions{RemoteName: "origin"} to push local commits to upstream
calls repo.Head().Hash().String() and records the SHA in head_sha
deletes the workspace directory under WORKSPACE_ROOT, sets clone_status to "archived" and status to "archived", updates updated_at in the database
returns HTTP 200 with the updated workspace JSON
calls POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/reactivate on an archived workspace
sets status to "active", clone_status to "pending", clears clone_error, and updates the database row
enqueues a reclone job on the job queue using the workspace's git_url and branch
returns HTTP 200 with workspace JSON containing status = "active" and clone_status = "pending"
picks up the reclone job and performs the same shallow clone operation as initial creation
sets clone_status to "ready" and records head_sha on success

execution_paths.title: Happy path: delete archived workspace with cleanup

steps.action: calls DELETE /api/v1/workspaces/:slug on an archived workspace
checks whether the workspace directory exists under WORKSPACE_ROOT
if the directory exists, deletes it using os.RemoveAll; logs a warning if deletion fails but continues
deletes the workspace database row and returns HTTP 204

execution_paths.title: End-to-end: full workspace lifecycle from create to delete

steps.action: calls afc workspace create with git_url and branch; receives HTTP 201 with clone_status = "pending"
clones the repository into <WORKSPACE_ROOT>/<slug>/trunk/ and sets clone_status to "ready"
calls afc workspace get and observes clone_status = "ready" and a valid head_sha
calls POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/archive; handler pushes to upstream, records head_sha, deletes local clone, sets clone_status = "archived"
calls POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/reactivate; handler sets clone_status = "pending" and enqueues reclone job
re-clones the repository and sets clone_status to "ready"
calls POST /api/v1/workspaces/:slug/archive again to archive the workspace
calls DELETE /api/v1/workspaces/:slug; handler removes any remaining directory and deletes the database row; returns HTTP 204

execution_paths.title: Failure path: clone fails and workspace enters failed state

steps.action: calls POST /api/v1/workspaces with an invalid or unreachable git_url; receives HTTP 201 with clone_status = "pending"
picks up the clone job, sets clone_status to "cloning", and calls PlainCloneContext
PlainCloneContext returns an error; worker removes any partial workspace directory
sets clone_status to "failed" and records the error message in clone_error
calls afc workspace get and observes clone_status = "failed" and clone_error containing the error message

error_handling.condition: WORKSPACE_ROOT directory cannot be created on server boot
error_handling.behavior: server logs a fatal error and exits with a non-zero exit code

error_handling.condition: PlainCloneContext returns a non-nil error during a clone job
error_handling.behavior: worker sets clone_status to "failed", records error in clone_error, and removes any partially created workspace directory
returns HTTP 409 with message "clone in progress; try again after it completes"

error_handling.condition: repo.Push returns an error other than NoErrAlreadyUpToDate during archive
error_handling.behavior: archive fails with HTTP 500; workspace directory is not deleted; clone_status and status remain unchanged

error_handling.condition: PlainOpen fails because trunk directory is missing during archive of a ready workspace
error_handling.behavior: returns HTTP 500 with the error message; clone_status and status are not modified

error_handling.condition: repo.Head() returns an error after a successful push during archive
error_handling.behavior: returns HTTP 500; workspace directory is not deleted

error_handling.condition: Workspace directory deletion fails during archive after successful push and head_sha recording
error_handling.behavior: logs a warning but still sets clone_status to "archived" and status to "archived"; returns HTTP 200

error_handling.condition: Workspace directory deletion fails during DELETE /api/v1/workspaces/:slug
error_handling.behavior: logs a warning and proceeds to delete the database row; returns HTTP 204

error_handling.condition: Clone context is cancelled due to server shutdown while a clone is in progress
error_handling.behavior: PlainCloneContext returns a context cancellation error; worker sets clone_status to "failed" and removes any partial workspace directory

error_handling.condition: repo.Head() returns an error after a successful PlainCloneContext call
error_handling.behavior: worker sets clone_status to "failed", records the error in clone_error, and removes the workspace directory

error_handling.condition: Database update fails during reactivate before reclone job is enqueued
error_handling.behavior: returns HTTP 500 without enqueuing a reclone job; workspace state is unchanged
